title: R2-D2
description: Astromech Droids R2-D2 and C-3PO were on the Tantive IV when the ship was attacked. Princess Leia Organa hid the Death Star plans aboard the Droid. That information led the Droids, Kenobi, and Luke Skywalker to book passage with Han Solo. R2 flew with Luke in his X-wing during the Battle of Yavin, sustaining damage but receiving complete repairs.
